source_title: Tax Deeds | Marion County Clerk of Court and Comptroller
instructions: The list of Lands Available for Taxes is properties that were offered, but not purchased, at a Tax Deed Sale. After 90 days, any person or governmental unit may purchase the land for the opening bid, plus omitted years' taxes, as cited in Florida Administrative Code 12D-13.064(3). The current month's purchase amounts of the properties available for purchase can be found in the "Lands Available for Taxes Information" portion of this site. The purchase amount is payable by certified check, cashier's check, or money order. Recording fees of $10.00 for the first page and $8.50 for each additional page, and documentary stamps at 70 cents per hundred dollars are also collected. Upon receipt of the funds to purchase a property from the list of Lands Available for Taxes, a tax deed is issued as requested.
